en.headline: CK Hutchison first-half profit surges more than 30-fold on asset sales
en.dek: Reported profit attributable to shareholders reached HK$26.8 billion, driven by gains from UK infrastructure disposals; underlying profit rose about 7 per cent and the interim dividend increased 5 per cent.
body: CK Hutchison Holdings reported a sharp rise in first-half profit, with profit attributable to ordinary shareholders climbing to HK$26.8 billion from HK$852 million a year earlier, largely reflecting gains from the disposal of interests in UK Rails and UK Power Networks.

The group recognised gains of about HK$17.75 billion from those disposals, partly offset by a non-cash write-off of acquisition premiums. Excluding one-off items and the impact of UK telecoms assets, underlying profit rose approximately 7 per cent to around HK$12.6 billion. Revenue increased 6 per cent to HK$255.4 billion.

Chairman Victor Li Tzar-kuoi described the global environment in the first half as exceptionally turbulent and uncertain. The board declared an interim dividend of HK$0.7455 per share, up 5 per cent from a year earlier. Net debt to net total capital fell to a record low of 8.1 per cent after the asset sales strengthened the balance sheet.

Ports and related services revenue rose 4 per cent. Retail operations, including A.S. Watson, recorded solid growth, with Hong Kong retail showing a strong recovery. The group completed the disposal of its remaining interest in VodafoneThree in July, with the related gain to be recognised in the second half.

zh.headline: 長和上半年純利飆升逾30倍至268億元 派中期息0.7455元
zh.dek: 主要受惠出售英國基建資產收益，基本溢利升約7%；中期息按年增加5%，淨負債比率降至歷史低位。
body: 長和控股公布截至6月底止中期業績，股東應佔溢利達268億元，較去年同期的8.52億元大幅上升逾30倍，主要來自出售英國UK Rails及UK Power Networks權益所錄得的收益。
集團確認約177.5億元相關收益，同時錄得部分基建資產收購溢價的非現金撇銷。撇除一次性項目及英國電訊業務影響後，基本溢利約升7%至126億元左右，收入升6%至2554億元。
主席李澤鉅表示，上半年全球環境異常動盪及充滿不明朗因素。董事會宣派中期股息每股0.7455元，按年增加5%。資產出售後，淨債務對總資本淨額比率降至8.1%的歷史新低。
港口及相關服務收入升4%。零售業務包括屈臣氏集團表現穩健，香港零售業務錄得強勁復甦。集團於7月完成出售VodafoneThree剩餘權益，相關收益將於下半年確認。
